description.value: Pedal & Tap is a bar and restaurant set in Kimberley's Platzl, a pedestrian plaza in the heart of downtown, with a name that gives a knowing wink to cycling culture. The kitchen turns out creative, scratch-made dishes — from Vietnamese pork meatball bowls to panko-crusted seafood cakes — alongside a full bar with draught beer, cocktails, and seasonal happy hour specials. The outdoor-recreation-friendly vibe, reinforced by the hashtag #getmuckedup, makes it a natural gathering spot for cyclists finishing a day on the trails.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active bar and restaurant at 215 Spokane Street in Kimberley's Platzl; the phone number (250) 427-3325 appears consistently across all pages though it was absent from the OSM record. The menu explicitly labels multiple dishes as Vegetarian, Vegan, or Gluten-free, and the contact page details a phone-based takeout ordering system. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refills, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific infrastructure appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number (250) 427-3325 sourced from website only.
The /jobs subpage carries the HTML title 'Covid Protocol' despite its content being a current job posting — minor website inconsistency, not a closure indicator.
OSM amenity tag is 'bar' but the business operates as a full bar and restaurant with a substantial food menu.
No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information confirmed from the website; all three required criteria remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Pedal & Tap is an active, cycling-themed bar and restaurant in a prime pedestrian-plaza location in Kimberley offering food, drink, and phone-order takeout — a clear fit for the WWC directory, though on-the-ground confirmation of bike parking would strengthen the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located 'In the Platzl' per the contact page. The jobs page references a December 2026 posting date, confirming the business is actively operating and hiring as of mid-2026.
